changelog.change: The first plan: conversations.conversation_archived and conversations.conversation_unarchived, with a conversations.conversation snapshot (the reference flow of ADR 0020).

The conversations module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#325): 40 events for flags, streams, labels, needs, drafts and sends, taught rules and their runs, suggestions, person notes, provider batches, the model pass, Scout's reads and inboxes; records draft, need, rule and rule_run; Coverage for every operation, job, schedule and handler of the module.

The identity module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#326): 27 events for sign-ins succeeded and refused, accounts created, sessions ended, ways in and passkeys added and removed, suspensions, workspace and registered apps, consents, held mailbox grants, and token exchanges, reuse and revocation; records account, session, way_in, passkey, client and consent; Coverage for every operation, handler and schedule of the module.

The web BFF instrumented (campbooks-cloud#327): 3 events for web sessions started, ended one at a time (logging out, signing in again, a copied cookie, outdated scopes, a refused refresh, unreadable tokens, an expired access token) and ended at once (back-channel logout, signing out everywhere, a suspension); the enums of how they end; Coverage for every operation, handler and schedule of the BFF. bff is a platform module, generated into the kernel and tracked from the server.

The workspaces module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#328): 16 events for workspaces created, updated, deleted and purged, members joined, role changed, left, suspended and unsuspended, invitations created, signup requests filed, approved and rejected, and signup codes minted, revoked and redeemed; records workspace, member, invitation, signup_request and signup_code; Coverage for every operation, handler and job of the module; the conversations and identity exemptions name workspaces.workspace_deleted.

The connectors module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#329): 10 events for connections added, reconnected, removed, their health changed and a sync asked for, sync runs (one summary per run, with counts), the outbound changes a run made (counts by end), calendar changes completed, and sends succeeded or failed; records connection, stream and send; Coverage for every operation, job, schedule and handler of the module; the identity operations that hand it a grant name the connection events.

The assistant, attention, search and system modules instrumented (campbooks-cloud#330): 15 events for chats with Scout started, continued, answered and deleted, its proposals confirmed, declined and undone, a member's profile updated, an item snoozed and unsnoozed, a workspace's daily AI limit reached, and (the kernel's queue, from the system admin actions) a dead job retried or discarded, a kind's dead jobs retried and a schedule's stuck run discarded; records chat, answer, proposal, profile, item and job; Coverage for every operation, job, schedule and handler of the four modules (search and the telemetry reports exempt).

The admin module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#331): 2 instance-wide events for an administrator's profile granted (created or given more permissions) and revoked (permissions taken away or the profile removed) by the server's admin command, as system; record profile and enum permission; no Coverage rows (the module serves no operation and runs no job, schedule or handler).

The schedule module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#349): 16 events for events of a calendar created, edited (which fields), moved (the times before), cancelled by a later email, deleted, restored, answered (the answer before), pushed to a provider calendar and unpushed, calendars added by a grant, enabled, disabled, recoloured and removed with their connection, settings updated (which settings), and one summary per batch of a provider's changes applied (counts); records calendar_event, calendar_event_times, calendar and settings; Coverage for every operation, job and handler of the module, apply_outcome and release_delete naming connectors.calendar_change_completed.

The tasks module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#340): 8 events for a task created (by a member, or by Scout from an ask), edited (which fields), its due date changed (the date before), planned (the plan before), done, not needed, reopened (the state before) and reassigned (handed off or taken back, with the member who had it); records task, task_due and task_plan; Coverage for every operation, job and handler of the module.

Time held for a task (campbooks-cloud#362): tasks.task_held (minutes, moved, by the member or the calendar, the kind of calendar) and tasks.task_hold_released (minutes, by); enums hold_actor and hold_calendar; Coverage for tasks.hold, tasks.release_hold and the follow_hold handlers, and the hold released by tasks.done, tasks.not_needed and tasks.hand_off.

The pages module instrumented (campbooks-cloud#363): 8 events for a page made, edited (which fields), moved (where it was), shared with a member (their role, and the one they had), unshared, trashed, restored and deleted for good; records page and page_location; Coverage for every operation, job, schedule and handler of the module.

Coverage required with no baseline (campbooks-cloud#332): 2 connectors events for an IMAP mailbox's address check asked for again and its message sent or not (with why); Coverage rows for connectors.check_address, connectors.send_address_check, search.on_page_changed and the kernel's maintenance schedules and change-feed sequencer.

Invitations awaiting an answer on Home (campbooks-cloud#360): Coverage for schedule.release_response (connectors.calendar_change_completed), schedule.dispatch_invitation_backfills, schedule.announce_invitations and attention.project_invitation; no new event.

Instance apps (campbooks-cloud#369): 3 instance-wide events for an instance app registered, its secret rotated and its removal (with the consents and refresh tokens it held) by the server's admin command, as system; the client kind instance; the instance apps' app_ ids in every client-id pattern; no Coverage rows (the CLI serves no operation and runs no job, schedule or handler).

Sync with Notion (campbooks-cloud#376): provider notion and capability pages for connections; 5 pages events for pages imported from Notion (how many), a sync applied in either direction (how many blocks), a conflict raised, a conflict resolved (the choice) and a sync stopped (why); Coverage for every operation, job and handler of the change.

Tables in pages (campbooks-cloud#365): 5 pages events for a table made, a property added (its type), a view made (its type), a table queried (rows answered, in buckets) and cells edited (how many, in buckets); Coverage for every operation of the change.

Notion databases as tables (campbooks-cloud#377): 4 pages events for databases imported as tables (how many), a table's changes crossing to or from Notion (direction, how many), a column or cell changed on both sides (what kind, how many) and a member's choice for one (what kind, what choice); Coverage for every operation, job and handler of the change.

You replied. Done? (campbooks-cloud#396): tasks.task_reply_noticed (a reply of the member in the conversation an open Do task came from) and tasks.task_reply_answered (the member answered Not yet); Coverage for tasks.notice_replies, tasks.answer_reply and tasks.unanswer_reply.
Attaching a file to a draft (campbooks-cloud#391): Coverage for conversations.upload_draft_attachment, which tracks conversations.draft_updated as a save does.
